name: Manastorm Stratholme: a solo wipe at Magistrate Barthilas ejects the player to the faction hub on release (#8179, #8083)
contract: #8179/#8083: a wiped solo Manastorm run could never reach ManastormMgr::HandleReleaseAfterWipe because
AscensionDungeonRelease's generic InstanceStart fallback (any areatrigger_teleport row whose
target_mapId matches the current map) always matched Stratholme's public entrance rows and claimed
the release first, short-circuiting PLAYERHOOK_CAN_REPOP_AT_GRAVEYARD before manastorm_playerscript's
own boolean handler ever ran. The player was resurrected at 50% HP and near-teleported to the public
entrance while still inside the private Manastorm instance, and ManastormMgr::FailRun was never called:
the run stayed stuck in AwaitingExit ("manastorm still running, can't release").
The fix adds an OnPlayerReleasedGhost handler to manastorm_playerscript. That hook is dispatched by
CALL_ENABLED_HOOKS (every registered script runs, unlike the short-circuiting boolean hook) and fires
from Player::BuildPlayerRepop before WorldSession::HandleRepopRequestOpcode calls RepopAtGraveyard, so
the wipe ejection to the faction hub now always runs before AscensionDungeonRelease's fallback gets a
This scenario proves setup correctness (private run, Active stage, boss safety bubble cleared) up to
the kill, then drives an actual wipe (self-damage death, no resurrection charge used) and release
through the native CMSG_REPOP_REQUEST path the harness's 'release_spirit' action sends, exactly as
the client does, and asserts the player lands at the Horde Manastorm hub pad re-added in #9640
(gameobject 6901539, map 1) rather than staying stuck in the private instance.

steps.label: The player entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the instance is visible to this lane
Leaving the preparation bubble at the boss clears its safety aura and the stage goes Active
CONTROL: the lone member's death wiped the run
The wipe ejected the player out of the private Manastorm instance
The release resurrected the player instead of leaving them stuck as a ghost in the instance
The player landed on Kalimdor, where the Horde Manastorm hub pad is
The player landed at the Horde Manastorm hub pad, not a Stratholme entrance
